command:
set -eu
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libgtk-3-0 libgl1 libegl1 libglu1-mesa libxss1 libgstreamer1.0-0 libgstreamer-plugins-base1.0-0 libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 libsecret-1-0 xvfb xauth
mkdir -p /selected/provider-source
tar -xf /tmp/selected-upstream.tar -C /selected/provider-source
cd /selected
chmod +x /tmp/selected.AppImage
/tmp/selected.AppImage --appimage-extract
uv venv --python 3.12 /selected/venv
uv pip install --python /selected/venv/bin/python /selected/provider-source mcp==1.28.1
chmod -R a+rX /selected
